title: Generation-first daily quality correction
summary: Project iteration record for moving public AI daily prose quality back into report:draft generation. The repair contract remains a fallback: the generator now deterministically rewrites English source titles and evidence into Chinese reader-facing main items, hero highlights, and hot blog titles, summaries, and key points before quality review.

validation_commands: node --test tests/unit.test.js --test-name-pattern "draft generator emits reader-facing Chinese sections without AI repair"

lessons.lesson: AI repair should not become the normal daily publishing product surface.
lessons.evidence: The 2026-06-17 run was publishable only after a codex_ai_repair_contract step rewrote English or thin public prose; the new unit fixture now requires report:draft plus reviewReportQuality to pass without AI repair tasks.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep adding deterministic generation-side fixtures whenever a public prose repair is observed, and use repair only for exceptional unknown wording.

lessons.lesson: Generic English-to-Chinese fallback must not promote ranking source labels into public summary copy.
lessons.evidence: The first implementation made a GitHub ranking-source regression visible; the actor-label guard now maps GitHub project candidates to a neutral project label instead of the ranking feed name.
lessons.recommended_action: Treat ranking and aggregator labels as provenance, not reader-facing event actors, when generating fallback copy.

suggestions.issue: Main items, hero highlights, and hot blogs could receive English source titles and thin evidence-derived prose, causing the normal runner to enter AI repair.
suggestions.evidence: The red test failed on leaked title text such as `OpenAI details how simulated conversations support model deployments`; after the draft generator change, the same fixture passes reviewReportQuality with no ai_review_tasks.
suggestions.suggestion: Use deterministic English signal profiles to create Chinese headlines, summaries, details, and hot blog points from source title and evidence before public quality review.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Normal daily runs are more likely to publish directly from generation when source facts are sufficient, while low-signal cases can still be refused or repaired as fallback.
suggestions.promotion_path: Implemented in draft generation and bound to the unit test `draft generator emits reader-facing Chinese sections without AI repair` plus existing page and publish quality gates.
validation_evidence: draft generator emits reader-facing Chinese sections without AI repair
report:draft does not backfill must read highlights from GitHub ranking cells

followups.action: Extend the same generation-first quality fixture pattern to Builder and community sections after the first main/hero/hot-blog pass is merged.
